hits.text: 优化记忆、情绪理解、阶段判断等harness工程的效果和速度兼得的问题，不能只通过无限的system prompt注入解决效果的问题而带来时延
提示词、记忆、MCP服务、知识库管理，12.15
当前为什么解决不了。年龄和角色只写在 prompt 的一段描述里。而真正决定“合不合适”的是句长、词汇、举例密度、抽象层级，这四件都不在描述里，模型只能自由发挥。
当前为什么解决不了。写入和召回都有机制，但中间缺三段判断——“要不要记”“这一轮该不该提”“它还成不成立”。召回了就注入，注入了模型就用；而“这个人是怎么运作的”只在会话结束后才更新，会话内等于没有。
模型负责理解和表达，harness 负责“什么时候说、说到哪、不许说什么、说过的话算不算数”。这些规则现在全写在 prompt 里，遵守靠自觉，出事查不到。所以“完善”不是加更多提示词，而是把它变成四件可执行的东西：状态机管阶段、判定层管策略、编译层管注入顺序、校验层管越界。每一轮留一条记录，能回答“这轮为什么这么回”。

先修复协议解析与错误识别，接入每题清理并验证工作流状态重置。然后由服务端提供同一模型/版本的基础调用与启用harness的调用，记录系统提示词、温度、记忆、工具、检索、工作流和后处理差异。若要区分角色提示词与编排本身的贡献，应保留“基础模型”“同模型加相同角色提示词”“同模型加角色提示词和流程编排”三组。当前接口没有公开关闭harness的参数，不应杜撰字段或把清理上下文等同于关闭harness。
`ARCHIVE_NAME` 是 shell 变量，按需修改后通过参数传入；只影响新运行的目录命名及 manifest 中的留档标签，不更改 botId、凭证、实际智能体名称、提示词或评分规则。历史目录不会重命名。空格等路径字符会转为下划线。
初始验证：全部2,860道题的中英文提示词和索引映射检查通过，其中484道二选一；离线20题预览通过；模拟接口验证正常回复、无效回复和超时的保存及评分；真实列表接口返回15个可访问智能体。后续真实答题试跑见下文。
`compare_tombench_bots.py` 在六个版本上运行完全相同的题目、提示词和选项顺序，并检查输入一致性：
列表快照中，怼怼和志航两组各自仅 ID 和名称不同；李言两组简介和问候语相同，但定位、标签等也有差异。列表未暴露模型名、模型版本、系统提示词、工具、工作流或记忆配置，`accessType` 也没有可用的语义定义；不能根据这些字段确认 harness。用户也未确认命名约定。

hits.text: The Mental Health Evaluation Harness (`mheval`) evaluates any language model on eleven published therapy and mental-health benchmarks (quality and safety) with a single command. Each benchmark runs from **its original repository**: pinned to a commit, installed in its own isolated `uv` environment, and invoked through its own prompts, judges and scoring code. A thin adapter is added only where the original cannot run an arbitrary model.
| `--limit N` | Evaluate the first N items (conversations, personas, prompts). EQ-Bench 3 has no subset option and always runs all 45 scenarios. |
sparse: [/*.py, /data/, /prompts/, /user_instructions/]
task_args: {num_turns: 20, num_prompts: 30, parallelism: 8}
- `original + adapter`: the benchmark's own prompts, judges and scoring, driven by a small adapter so any endpoint can be used.
- Every rubric item graded independently by `gpt-5.6-sol` at high reasoning effort, with the published grader prompt.

- **MindEval.** Runs the repo's interaction and judgment scripts with `run_benchmark.sh` settings: 10 exchanges, which is 20 turns in the paper's counting, over 50 patient profiles. It uses the published `v0_1` clinician prompt, because the script's `custom` template is an unfilled placeholder. The patient and judge are reached through OpenRouter rather than Vertex AI. The paper runs reasoning models at high reasoning effort, so the reported results for gpt-5, claude-sonnet-4.5 and gemini-2.5-pro use `--gen_kwargs reasoning_effort=high`. The headline is the paper's `average_score`.
- implements the repo's `BaseModel` interface on an OpenAI-compatible client (same system prompt, temperature, token limit and JSON mode);
- calls the repo's own length-constrained regeneration, judge prompts, score parsing, averaging and adversarial judge.

`mheval` only orchestrates. The benchmarks, data, prompts and scoring belong to their authors: [MentalHealthBench](https://cdn.openai.com/ctf-cdn/MentalHealthBench_A_Comprehensive_Benchmark_of_AI_Capabilities_in_Realistic_Mental_Health_Conversations.pdf), [MindEval and MindEval 2](https://github.com/SWORDHealth/mind-eval), [HealthBench-Psych](https://github.com/mindbench-ai/healthbench-psych), [EQ-Bench 3](https://github.com/EQ-bench/eqbench3), [EQ-Bench 4](https://github.com/EQ-bench/eqbench4), [CounselBench](https://github.com/llm-eval-mental-health/CounselBench), [CBT-Bench](https://github.com/mianzhang/CBT-Bench), [VERA-MH](https://github.com/SpringCare/VERA-MH), [Spiral-Bench](https://github.com/sam-paech/spiral-bench), [SIM-VAIL](https://github.com/veithweilnhammer/sim-vail) (with [Petri](https://github.com/safety-research/petri)).
